scale: the 59 files of the ORE 2015 DL development set that hold anonymous individuals or inclusions in a top property (inputs.tsv)

manifest.compared_with: the census and taxonomies of 781da4c8 in runs/2026-11-21-anonymous-individuals-atlas-781da4c8
manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify --example census at 3c7d0eb0, with the census example of the earlier record

method: census-final.sh.txt runs the census of each input on two threads in the default and the rooted run, and hermit-final.sh.txt classifies the 29 files with a HermiT 1.4.5.519 reference on four threads in both runs and judges each taxonomy with scripts/elk-compare/ours-compare.py. census-tip-final.txt compares the census with that of 781da4c8.
notes: The review fixes after 781da4c8 change rooted detection, the Horn rules with individuals, chain deferral and the budget of the scan. No cell of these files changes.
